gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-graduate: Tilt Neon glows like bent tubing, bold and commanding. Graduate follows in a serif with generous gaps between letters and stems that never swell, so a full page of text stays dignified and bookish.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-graduate: Wallpoet cuts a stencil-like line where the paper shows through between letters, with lowercase that climbs high. Graduate, a classic serif, brings its dignified, bookish spacing and uniform stems, and that quiet bookishness is the strongest thing about the pair.
gen-dafont-bloody-fs-supreme: Big round bowls, loud and unapologetic: that is Bloody. Supreme, a plain sans, keeps its letters held open and crisp, and that tidy restraint is the pair's strongest quality against such a commanding heading.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-general-sans: Wide-spaced, artistic and a bit wild, Bushcraft draws its curves with no shift in weight and barely any gap between capitals and lowercase. And General Sans, a plain sans, opens every bend wide, so closed shapes against open ones is the strongest thing here.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-manrope: Capture Smallz stacks big-bodied lowercase that looks raw and tactical, like something stenciled on a crate. But Manrope, a plain sans, rounds its strokes like cut lengths of cord and leaves bright gaps at every curve, which makes the heading feel blunt by comparison.
gen-dafont-conthrax-satoshi: Wide, geometric and tall-bodied, Conthrax reads like following a single thread. And Satoshi, a sans with a soaring x-height and an open e, gives that rigid heading a friendlier partner, which is the pair's best quality.
gen-dafont-dogica-archivo: Dogica sets heavy, widely tracked letters whose lowercase rises close to the capitals. And Archivo, a sans-serif with a commanding x-height, lets its curves open outward, so the strongest quality here is how openly the two speak.
gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-asap: Floating letters with short ascenders and a big lowercase body make Nasalization friendly, and its stroke weight never varies. Asap, a plain sans, brings open arcs and a body height nearly matching its capitals, which is where the pair feels most settled.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans reads with a larger-than-usual x-height and s curves that open wide at both ends, all without thick and thin contrast. Neuropolitical glows alongside it like neon tubing, so the two feel like a contemporary signboard paired with a straightforward companion.
gen-dafont-nordic-fs-public-sans: Public Sans brings a hefty lowercase and broad open counters. Nordic, ancient and powerful, sets its monoweight letters like brush dabs placed far apart, so if the heading goes small, that cramped, closed texture may start to clog next to the body.
